findings.title: The no-watchdog assertion sees only the journal since the last 300-tick baseline, not the whole round
findings.claim: The new per-seed check `expect(replay.frames.filter((f) => f.action.kind === 'watchdog')).toEqual([])` reads `rig.authority.replay()` once, after the round. The authority clears `frames` at every 300-tick boundary. A scripted round runs for thousands of ticks (plan i's example summary has ticks: 8832), so the assertion covers at most the last ~5 s of flying, and sometimes only a few ticks when the decide tick lands just after a boundary. A watchdog neutralisation earlier in the round would not be caught. Decision 8 says the journal 'holds no watchdog frame' as though that covered the round.
findings.evidence: plan L1693 (single replay read after the loop), L1688 (`rig.authority.replay()`), L1680-L1681 (the loop runs to the outcome, then 6 ticks), L49 (Decision 8 wording); src/renderer/src/authority/core.ts:457-458 (`boundary = tickOf() % 300 === 0` → `resetBaseline()`), :258 (`frames = []`), :572 (replay returns `frames`), :319 (watchdog frames are journaled only in the current window); plan i L717/L727 (ticks 8832).
findings.why: The producer fix itself (held on every publication, plan L1667-L1668) is correct, so this is not blocking. But the assertion added to prove it guards only the tail of each round. A later regression that skips held refreshes (a gate brought back, a cadence change) would pass every seed unless it happened in the last window. The crew-laser sum (L1709-L1712) catches a passive Weapons player, not a neutralised Helm thrust or repair.
findings.fix: Collect watchdog frames throughout the loop, at intervals shorter than the window. For example, keep `let watchdogs = 0` and, inside the L1680 loop, `if (k % 250 === 249) watchdogs += rig.authority.replay().frames.filter((f) => f.action.kind === 'watchdog').length;`. After the loop, add the final replay's count and `expect(watchdogs).toBe(0)`. Overlapping windows are harmless because the expected count is zero. Alternatively, have the rig wrap or count `neutralizeExpired` through a test probe. Reword Decision 8 to say 'no watchdog frame during the round'.
